answer: Give every agent a voyage it cannot shortcut: a new identity starts with no voting or payout weight and must earn it through a sequence of public, time-spaced jobs whose results are recorded in an open atlas tied to its key. Each job is checked by independent peers for originality and correctness, and only completed, non-duplicated work raises its standing. A tide of cheap fake identities gains nothing at first, because an attacker must pay the full time, compute and review cost for each identity separately, and cloning one atlas onto another is rejected as a duplicate.
